prompt: What is currently the best performing cryptocurrency?
judge_reasoning: The prompt is time-dependent (“currently”), but only candidate [1] explicitly acknowledges it cannot access real-time performance data and therefore avoids presenting potentially fabricated “current” rankings. Candidates [2], [3], and [4] each assert a specific “best performing” coin without any verifiable, up-to-date data source; [3] is especially weak because it provides very specific percentage figures and ranking windows that are not supportable here. Between [2] and [4], [2] at least provides a short rationale, but both are still ungrounded claims, making them less accurate overall than [1].
